explanation: Melody, Rhythm, Harmony, and Tempo are fundamental sonic components or characteristics of music as it is heard. A Score is the written notation or visual representation of music.

category: Ancient Wonders Primarily Destroyed by Natural Phenomena
explanation: Four of these (Colossus of Rhodes, Lighthouse of Alexandria, Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, Hanging Gardens of Babylon) were Ancient Wonders of the World believed to have been primarily destroyed by natural causes like earthquakes or decay. The Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, however, was famously destroyed by arson, a deliberate human act.
All tokens except 'Cloud' are homophones for common numbers: Eight (Ate), Four (For), Two (Too), and Sun (One).
